contract.fallback: Unallocated capital remains in US-INDEX-BASKET close-to-close.
contract.signalTiming: Parent strategies already enforce post-signal execution; NGAS Winter Alpha only combines parent daily ledgers and recalculates costs.
contract.selectionPolicy: Only predeclared parent-blend policies and bounded gas-overlay risk multipliers are selected on train and validation. Generic idle-index risk-off variants are reported as diagnostics only, and holdout rows after 2025-11-01 are reported after selection.
contract.overfitControl: No holdout rows are used for selection. Parent candidates were selected by their own train/validation generators, and this layer only chooses a fixed blend policy plus one predeclared weather-resolution overlay and one bounded gas-overlay risk multiplier. Volatility Mean Reversion is used only as a predeclared same-direction fade confirmer while portfolio-level risk-off overlays stay diagnostic.
contract.weatherResolutionTiming: Weather-resolution overlays use GFS/GEFS lead-1 to lead-3 forecasts with issueDate <= entryTradeDate, or NASA POWER actual anomalies only when targetDate < entryTradeDate.

selected.architectureLabel: Short fade plus cold follow and 75% vol-confirmed long fade + Grade reversion size by close-in weather shift + 1.25x gas-overlay risk budget
selected.architectureDescription: Take Dual Weather cold-follow setups directly; keep Weather Hybrid reversion-short setups, adding Dual Weather warm-short exposure when both parent experts point short, and add 75%-sized Weather Hybrid reversion-long setups only when Volatility Mean Reversion confirms the same long-fade direction. Weather-resolution overlay: Scale reversion exposure up when the close-in or already-known actual anomaly confirms the reversion, and shrink it when the weather shift argues against the trade. Portfolio risk-budget overlay: scale active gas exposure by 1.25x, capped at 0.6x, without changing signal selection.
